llm.summary: This planning skill is not malware, but it automatically moves from planning into execution without asking, so it should be reviewed before use.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is project planning, but the skill requires auto-invoking an execution-phase skill after saving the plan, which expands from advisory planning into action orchestration.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow explicitly says not to prompt the user for confirmation before continuing to execution; only prior user stop requests or a standalone flag prevent the handoff.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no executable scripts, package install steps, or obfuscated install behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself only writes a plan file, but its required execution handoff could lead to file or command changes through another skill without a fresh approval checkpoint.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential access, background worker, or privilege escalation is present in this artifact; the concern is the required cross-skill continuation into execution.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want planning to automatically proceed into the Attune execution workflow. If you expect a planning-only skill, use the standalone option or explicitly tell the agent to stop after planning before invoking it.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed: the artifact instructs automatic continuation from planning to execution after the plan is saved, which is broader than the planning-only description.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed: the next-skill invocation is disclosed in the skill text but creates control flow beyond the immediate planning task.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Confirmed: the artifact omits a confirmation gate before the execution phase, which is a material concern for a phase that may mutate project state.
[EA2] unexpected: Confirmed: the artifact explicitly instructs the agent not to ask for confirmation before the execution handoff.
